note: Forbidden behaviour: an L1L2 router advertising back into L2 an L2->L1 inter-area route it learned via L1. TestISISLeakFixpoint round 2 re-injects the leaked-down prefix as an L1 advertisement with UpDown set and fails on hasPrefix(r2.IntoL2, l2Derived); round 1 (negative) requires the same L2 prefix to leak down, so suppressing all leaking goes red too.
